entries.title: Romans 16:1
segments: I commend to your care our Sister, Phoebe, who helps in the work of the Church at Cenchreae;

entries.title: Romans 16:2
segments: And I ask you to give her a Christian welcome--one worthy of Christ's People--and to aid her in any matter in which she may need your assistance. She has proved herself a staunch friend to me and to many others.

entries.title: Romans 16:3
segments: Give my greeting to Prisca and Aquila, my fellow-workers in the Cause of Christ Jesus,

entries.title: Romans 16:4
segments: Who risked their own lives to save mine. It is not I alone who thank them, but all the Churches among the Gentiles thank them also.

entries.title: Romans 16:5
segments: Give my greeting, also, to the Church that meets at their house, as well as to my dear friend Epaenetus, one of the first in Roman Asia to believe in Christ;

entries.title: Romans 16:6
segments: To Mary, who worked hard for you;

entries.title: Romans 16:7
segments: To Andronicus and Junias, my countrymen and once my fellow- prisoners, who are men of note among the Apostles, and who became Christians before I did;

entries.title: Romans 16:8
segments: To my dear Christian friend Ampliatus;

entries.title: Romans 16:9
segments: To Urban, our fellow-worker in the Cause of Christ, and to my dear friend Stachys;

entries.title: Romans 16:10
segments: To that proved Christian Apelles; to the household of Aristobulus;

entries.title: Romans 16:11
segments: To my countryman Herodion; to the Christians in the household of Narcissus;

entries.title: Romans 16:12
segments: To Tryphaena and Tryphosa, who have worked hard for the Master; to my dear friend Persis, for she has done much hard work for the Master;

entries.title: Romans 16:13
segments: To that eminent Christian, Rufus, and to his mother, who has been a mother to me also;

entries.title: Romans 16:14
segments: To Asyncritus, Phlegon, Hermes, Patrobas, Hermas, and the Brothers with them;

entries.title: Romans 16:15
segments: Also to Philologus and Julia, Nereus and his sister, and Olympas, and to all Christ's People who are with them.

entries.title: Romans 16:16
segments: Greet one another with a sacred kiss. All the Churches of the Christ send you greetings.

entries.title: Romans 16:17
segments: I urge you, Brothers, to be on your guard against people who, by disregarding the teaching which you received, cause divisions and create difficulties; dissociate yourselves from them.

entries.title: Romans 16:18
segments: For such persons are not serving Christ, our Master, but are slaves to their own appetites; and, by their smooth words and flattery, they deceive simple-minded people.

entries.title: Romans 16:19
segments: Every one has heard of your ready obedience. It is true that I am very happy about you, but I want you to be well versed in all that is good, and innocent of all that is bad.

entries.title: Romans 16:20
segments: And God, the giver of peace, will before long crush Satan under your feet. May the blessing of Jesus, our Lord, be with you.

entries.title: Romans 16:21
segments: Timothy, my fellow-worker, sends you his greetings, and Lucius, Jason, and Sosipater, my countrymen, send theirs.

entries.title: Romans 16:22
segments: I Tertius, who am writing this letter, send you my Christian greeting.

entries.title: Romans 16:23
segments: My host Gaius, who extends his hospitality to the whole Church, sends you his greeting; and Erastus, the City Treasurer, and Quartus, our Brother, add theirs.

entries.title: Romans 16:24
segments: (Translation omits this verse)

entries.title: Romans 16:25
segments: Now to him who is able to strengthen you, as promised in the Good News entrusted to me and in the proclamation of Jesus Christ, in accordance with the revelation of that hidden purpose, which in past ages was kept secret but now has been revealed

entries.title: Romans 16:26
segments: And, in obedience to the command of the Immortal God, made known through the writings of the Prophets to all nations, to secure submission to the Faith--

entries.title: Romans 16:27
segments: To him, I say, the wise and only God, be ascribed, through Jesus Christ, all glory for ever and ever. Amen. (r)
